Name: American Paint Horse Mod
Author: PorcelainRose
Description:
I wanted an American Pant horse and couldn't find one, so I made one. Simple as that. 
Everyday on my commute I see an American Paint horse, who I've named Sugar, and I decided I wanted my Stardew Valley horse to look like Sugar. I'm actually pretty happy with how it turned out.

Installation:
Extract the file and copy horse.xnb to Folder/Stardew Valley/Content/Animals and replace the file in that destination.
MAKE SURE YOU BACKUP YOUR FILES BEFORE HAND!!
I think you can also use the ModManager. (I don't use it, but it should work, please tell me if it doesn't.)

Please let me know if there are any problems!


If you want, you can check out my other mod[url=http://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/626/?] here[/url].
